english.note: This is the all-purpose choice for saying someone is willing or ready to do something.
Use this when you want to state willingness explicitly or give it a more deliberate tone.
Use this when happy means willing or having no objection to doing something.

examples.english: I’m prepared to help you move house.
examples.jyutping: ngo5 jyun6 ji3 bong1 nei5 bun1 uk1

examples.english: I am willing to learn how to cook for my family.
examples.traditional: 我願意為咗屋企人學識煮飯。
examples.jyutping: ngo5 jyun6 ji3 wai6 zo2 uk1 kei2 jan4 hok6 sik1 zyu2 faan6

examples.english: If you want to go, I'm happy to go with you.
examples.traditional: 如果你想去，我願意陪你。
examples.jyutping: jyu4 gwo2 nei5 soeng2 heoi3 ngo5 jyun6 ji3 pui4 nei5
